comment: Only `id` is required - paste the sequentialId from the AHD site URL
Everything else - CEO, logo, financials, share register, bonds, credit
rating, sectors, tape - is filled in automatically by tools/fetch-intel.mjs.
You never hand-enter figures; this file only says WHICH corporations to track
threat  classification shown on the threat matrix
member  true  -> also counted as a Vanguard alliance member
alias   display override if the registered name is not what you want shown
note    free text shown on the dossier
autoMatchNote: Case-insensitive name patterns scanned against the full live corporation register on every refresh. Matches are added automatically, so a corporation that registers under a matching name shows up even if it is not listed in entries below.
